name: Battery Charge Limit Guardian
author: OpenRevo Official & Community
description: Official sample plugin: a multi-protocol low-level charge-limit control center built on the microkernel hardware gateway. Supports the TongFang pulse-storage method and the Bld dual-threshold protocol, freely setting a 1-100% charge threshold, with every parameter persisted per model and per target in a dual-track sandbox.

tongfang_pulse.name: TongFang pulse-triggered storage method (YaoShi / Wujie / Jiaolong / Kuangshi)
